notes.subject: והים הגבול וגבול
notes.rationale: Text is terse/defective: 'the sea the border and border' — KJV takes 'the great sea and the coast thereof', JPS 'the Great Sea being the border thereof'; the double גבול may read 'the sea and its border'

notes.subject: ye … ye
notes.rationale: Bambara copula and relativizer supplied; Hebrew has no verb in the clause

notes.subject: baji
notes.rationale: נחל is a winter-torrent/valley stream; rendered baji (stream river), the closest Bambara watercourse word

notes.subject: joshua 15:47
notes.rationale: Boundary clause: 'unto the brook of Egypt' with the Great Sea as the limit

translation: Ashdod ni a denmusow ni a duguw, Gaza ni a denmusow ni a duguw, fo Mitsrayim baji, ani kɔgɔba min ⟨ye⟩ ⟨dan⟩ ye, ani dan.
